purpose: Preserve comparison-specific volatile workspaces, hidden Pi configuration, generated trial files, grading copies, CUDA compute caches, and the exact temporary vBuf runtime/build tree after all six trials completed.
preservation_method: Copied to archives; original /var/tmp sources were left in place and untouched.

not_duplicated.model_artifacts: Remain in the existing local qualification cache; their SHA-256 identities are recorded in the trial manifests and qualification report.
not_duplicated.external_ggml_checkout: Left untouched at its pinned commit with its pre-existing modification; not copied into this snapshot.
not_duplicated.llama_cpp_checkout_and_build: Remain in the existing project checkout/build; trial manifests record the commit and binary hashes.
not_duplicated.captured_run_traces: Already committed under raw/runs/, raw/pilots/, and raw/infra-probes/; sandbox /tmp namespaces are ephemeral by design.
